Barista Academy

Elevating the Espresso Culture

In 2006, Delta Cafés established a team of professional baristas, launching a groundbreaking initiative within the CCC Barista Academy by Delta Cafés. Since then, these specialists have promoted espresso coffee culture, demonstrating how coffee can be more creative, surprising, and human. By balancing technique and passion, they reinvent flavours, colours, and experiences, elevating coffee consumption to a new level.

The magic of coffee begins here. Join our Baristas and transform the ordinary into the extraordinary. Discover our courses and elevate the coffee experience:

  • Introduction to the World of Coffee

    This is a 6-hour training session covering the history, botany, production, and tasting of coffee. Ideal for beginners.

    Sign up

  • Espresso

    An 8-hour training session to learn how to calibrate grinders, operate machines, and serve the perfect espresso.

    Sign up

  • Cappuccino

    8-hour course to create cappuccinos with proper emulsion and explore latte art and decoration.

    Sign up

  • Brewing

    A 6-hour training session on filtered coffee methods, grinding, and extraction techniques.

    Sign up
